incident-bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] High error rate detected on /generate (5xx/timeouts) — alert policy infra/api-5xx-spike triggered. Impacting ~2.8% requests over the last 3m. Paging maya (primary oncall).

maya (oncall): on it. Looking at dashboards now.

Ajay (sre): I see gateway 502s from api-gateway -> router at 10:32 UTC. Traces show a spike of cache misses hitting runtime pool.

Lucas (eng-runtime): I can pull kv-prefix-cache metrics. Give me a minute to query Prometheus.

maya (oncall): Nora, Samir — heads up for customer comms if this stays > 1% for 15m.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Query results: prefix_cache_miss_rate spiked from 0.6% to 18% at 10:30. eviction_rate also jumped. Latency for cache lookup increased.

Ajay (sre): Also seeing a high number of fast restarts for prefix-cache-worker pods (OOM?) on cluster-us-west-2. Logs show repeated LRU eviction thrash.

maya (oncall): Attaching a snippet of the worker log.

maya (oncall): ```
2026-05-12T10:30:37Z ERROR prefix-cache WorkerEvict loop: freed=0 attempted=1024 mem_low=true pid=1234
2026-05-12T10:30:37Z WARN  prefix-cache IntegrityCheck failed: checksum mismatch for key_prefix=usr:session:abcd
```

Samir (eng-ml): checksum mismatch = probable corruption on persisted LRU segments after GC/compaction. Could be caused by concurrent writes plus eviction.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Agreed. We're seeing a correlated pattern: heavy concurrent writes (model kv warming) + eviction storm = race where compaction leaves inconsistent entries. That returns malformed entries to runtime and triggers 500s.

Ajay (sre): Impact assessment: about 120 active customers had 5xx for some requests, primarily high-concurrency tails. Error budget at risk.

maya (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can try: 1) disable prefix cache on router layer (fail open to backend) 2) scale up prefix-cache replicas to absorb eviction pressure 3) roll back recent config that increased cache TTL/weighting. Thoughts?

Lucas (eng-runtime): Fastest low-risk: set router flag PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED=false for api-gateway to stop serving bad cached items and let backends handle requests (will increase latency/cost but reduce 5xx). I can flip the flag and monitor.

Ajay (sre): I'll prepare a transparent rollback of the cache config if needed. Also recommend enabling read-only mode on cache persistence to prevent further corruption.

maya (oncall): Do it Lucas. Notify before revert.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Flipping flag now on canary gateway hosts. Command: 
```bash
rbctl set feature.prefix_cache false --target=canary-gateway --reason="incident 1776501234"
```

Lucas (eng-runtime): Done on canary. Monitoring logs.

sre-bot: Canary change propagated to 2/2 hosts. No new 502s on canary in the last 30s.

maya (oncall): Roll to all gateways when canary stable for 2m.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Rolling to all gateways. ETA ~90s.

sre-bot: Rollout complete to all gateway nodes.

Ajay (sre): Early signal: 5xx rate dropped from 2.8% -> 0.7% in 3m after full rollout. Latency increased ~80ms p50 but overall success rate improved.

Nora (cs): Notifying top-10 customers that we mitigated the 5xx spike; working on post-incident update. Will hold off on broader comms until we have root cause.

Samir (eng-ml): For next steps: we should take a cache pod down to inspect on-disk segments and run integrity checks, and run a small repro harness simulating concurrent warms + eviction.

Lucas (eng-runtime): I'll schedule a controlled restart of one prefix-cache shard and mount the segment files read-only to check checksums. Setting maintenance window 11:10 UTC (non-urgent).

maya (oncall): Handing over to Ajay for next shift. I'm going to sleep — leave a follow-up checklist.

Ajay (sre): Acknowledged handoff. Open action items: 1) run deep integrity scan on persisted segments (Lucas) 2) add stronger checksums and guard in compaction (Samir + Lucas) 3) consider adaptive eviction backoff to prevent storms (eng-runtime) 4) customer postmortem draft (Nora).

Lucas (eng-runtime): Adding a short-term safety patch: if compaction detects checksum mismatch, mark segment stale and refuse reads instead of returning corrupted entries. Will push PR and hotfix after sandbox validation.

sre-bot: Incident created: incidents/1776501234 — severity P1-brief. Assigned owners: Lucas (runtime lead), Ajay (SRE), Nora (CS).

Nora (cs): Drafting customer update now. Will include mitigation steps and ETA for root-cause analysis.

Ajay (sre): Closing pager for now since error rate under threshold. Keeping channel open for follow-up. If we see recurrence, escalate to full outage.

maya (oncall): thanks team. Leaving notes in incident doc and tagging relevant alerts for tuning. :thumbsup:
